Excellent First Dining Experience — Mediterra Restaurant @ Mai House Saigon
Jun 2026 • Couples
We enjoyed our first dinner upon arriving in Ho Chi Minh City right here — conveniently connected to Mai House Saigon Hotel. Standout dishes included flavorful tricolor pasta, rich seafood casserole, and hearty ratatouille, all authentically Mediterranean and prepared with exceptionally fresh ingredients; warm toasted bread drizzled with olive oil completed the meal perfectly.

Service was truly attentive and professional. Our server Mr. Dat thoughtfully enhanced our sparkling water with freshly cut lemon slices and grated premium cheese from a block of cheese tableside for our pasta — a lovely personal touch. Ms. Chau welcomed us warmly and was highly responsive to our needs. She shared that the restaurant was newly opened in 2026, offered complimentary cookies, took photos for us, and even provided a discount voucher when she learned we planned to return.

We also enjoyed the restaurant’s cozy ambience with soft music in the background, perfect for chilling out after dinner. 

Great food, fresh flavours, caring service and cozy ambience made this a wonderful start to our trip. Highly recommended!

Sangria and cocktails are excellent!

Service: AMAZING! Somehow I reserved my table for the wrong date (totally my fault) and came 1 day earlier but Ms Thi (front desk lady) worked so hard to set up the birthday decoration instantly for me (blowing the balloons right then and there). My wait staff is Ms Châu who is attentive, knowledgeable and so gentle and looked after us so well all evening (we dined for around 4 hours). Her photography skill is top notch (trust me).

Ambiance: At 8pm they will change from warm lighting to pink/purple lighting and the whole place looks so beautiful! Price: Tbh for the high quality ingredient and great service and beautiful ambiance and decor, the price is quite fair and justified. Plus 1 more tapas, 2 mains,1 side,1 desert,1 sparkling water for a total of roughly 2,8million net price. We also got tiramisu for free as a gift for my birthday! Thank you so much!
